notes: Cal-Maine Foods (NASDAQ: CALM) — largest US shell egg producer (~20% market share). Fiscal year ends Saturday closest to May 31 (early June). Highly cyclical — earnings track the cage-free wholesale egg price (Urner Barry index). HPAI (avian influenza) outbreaks 2022-23 and 2024-25 disrupted supply, driving record egg prices. Dividend = 1/3 of net income (no fixed rate). No long-term debt. CIK 16933.

periods.notes: FY20 (ended May 30 2020): revenue $1.35B. Net loss $-3.0M (no dividends, per 1/3 NI policy). Pandemic egg price spike.
FY21 (ended May 29 2021): revenue $1.34B. Net loss $-2.6M. Minor dividend resumed.
FY22 (ended May 28 2022): revenue $1.78B (+33%). Net income $132M ($2.71/sh). HPAI driving strong pricing late in year.
FY23 (ended Jun 3 2023): revenue $3.15B (+77%). Net income $758M ($15.58/sh). Record egg prices from HPAI shortage. Dividend $5.34.
FY24 (ended Jun 1 2024): revenue $2.32B (-26% normalization). Net income $148M ($3.03/sh). Acquired ISE assets. Cash pile $813M, no debt.
